H1.title: Lower endosome pH
H1.statement: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes reduced endosome pH compared with APOE3.
H1.start_ref: Starting reference. Prasad H, Rao R. Amyloid clearance defect in ApoE4 astrocytes is reversed by epigenetic correction of endosomal pH. Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A. 2018;115(28):E6640-E6649. PMID 29946028.

H2.title: Impaired receptor recycling
H2.statement: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes impaired ARF6-related recycling of receptors between the cell surface and the endosome, compared with APOE3.
H2.start_ref: Starting reference. Rawat V, Wang S, Sima J, et al. ApoE4 Alters ABCA1 Membrane Trafficking in Astrocytes. J Neurosci. 2019;39(48):9611-9622. PMID 31641056.

H3.title: APOE4 aggregation in the endo-lysosome
H3.statement: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 undergoes increased aggregation in the endo-lysosome compared with APOE3.
H3.start_ref: Starting reference. Kaji S, Berghoff SA, Spieth L, et al. Apolipoprotein E aggregation in microglia initiates Alzheimer's disease pathology by seeding beta-amyloidosis. Immunity. 2024;57(11):2651-2668.e12. PMID 39419029.

H4.title: APOE4 adhesion to recycling receptors
H4.statement: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 adheres more tightly to some recycling receptors than APOE3, impeding recycling.
H4.start_ref: Starting reference. Xian X, Pohlkamp T, Durakoglugil MS, et al. Reversal of ApoE4-induced recycling block as a novel prevention approach for Alzheimer's disease. Elife. 2018;7:e40048. PMID 30375977.

H5.title: Lipid metabolism and late endosome function
H5.statement: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 disruption of lipid metabolism, compared with APOE3, results in impaired late endosome/lysosome function.
H5.start_ref: Starting reference. Lee H, Cho S, Kim MJ, et al. ApoE4-dependent lysosomal cholesterol accumulation impairs mitochondrial homeostasis and oxidative phosphorylation in human astrocytes. Cell Rep. 2023;42(10):113183. PMID 37777962.
